title: 交付文件工作台
thesis: 人和 Agent 围绕同一份打开的文件工作，每次交接都留下可以重新打开的版本、变更或 CSV。
journey: 负责人确认《任务导出设计》v3 → Lead 把 AC-02、读写路径和停止条件交给开发 → Lead 查验提交与局部自测 → Reviewer 用独立运行核对实际 CSV → Lead 集成，负责人确认后回写已有评审规则。复核发现问题时可把断言和 CSV 一并退回实施。

references.title: Uxerflow · Forge – AI Agent Code – Coding Workspace
references.observed: 2880×2160 官方封面的前景窗体平视。单独裁到 1536px 宽后，可见文件树、编辑器和会话约占 19%、48%、31%，窄间隙上是一层浅灰蓝窗体，白色文件标签和底部终端把代码与运行连在一起。树与会话可见字高约 13–15px，普通行距约 23–30px。官片 0.45 秒可见完整窗体，8.5 秒展开终端，12 秒可见运行和会话侧栏同时更新。

references.title: Uxerflow · Forge – AI Agent Code – Workspace
references.observed: 官方影片 8 秒附近的输入器把上下文与模型放在单行小控件中，选中项用紧凑描边。14.5 秒转入代码和会话并排，15.4 秒为完整三栏窗体，终端紧贴编辑器底边。采用后者的工作中状态与附着式输入区，项目选择移到 Fouc 顶栏。

pages.title: 确认《任务导出设计》v3
pages.focus: 林乔和需求 Agent 明确筛选、可见范围和 CSV 列，以 F-24 的反例签认 AC-02。确认操作把 v3 交给 Lead。
pages.method: 内置 ImageGen 引用了 Coding Workspace 的原版封面窗体裁切及 Workspace 15.4 秒的完整编辑器。生成稿确定文档与侧会话的并读布局。静态排版校准了字号、四条输入、两行 CSV 和确认控件，并保留了本轮生成的人像与 Agent 头像。
pages.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Build the first of a working Fouc desktop UX story in Chinese. The attached reference 1 is the cropped, legible entire application in Uxerflow's real Forge AI Agent Code – Coding Workspace; reference 2 is the studio's Workspace video at 15.4 seconds. Preserve their light, compact IDE fabric: icy bluish gray chassis, white one-pixel edged 8px-radius explorer, file editor and collaboration pane, file glyphs, slender compact segmented mode control, small black assistant avatar, mint action, calm black type, pale inset composer with model controls. Design a maximized desktop application at 1600 by 960 landscape (no monitor, wallpaper, margins, poster, marketing or oversized homepage). Single 48px top toolbar with Fouc wordmark and sole project selector “研发协作”, compact 文档 / 代码 / 运行 picker. Explorer width ~250px, large document editor ~825px, right conversation pane ~490px. Use crisp 12–14px Chinese body and 26–29px controls. First work at y=110. Real document tab task-export.md, title “任务导出设计” and “v3”, then “按筛选导出任务”. A terse Markdown design document, literal “AC-02 导出结果仅含当前筛选命中且本人可见的任务”; small four-record fixture matrix with F-18 and F-21 visible and matching, F-24 matching but invisible, F-33 visible and not matching; expected export two rows. In the right panel a real short requirements conversation between 林乔 and 需求 Agent, one compact action tile “确认 v3 并交给 Lead”. Keep the foreground document and chat real and typeset, with restrained rectangular material, near-black glyphs, a dark send circle, limited turquoise; generous empty white space below work. No made-up numerical KPI, kanban, poster headline, ribbons, cards for decoration, no repeated toolbar. All other branding and source demo text replaced.

hotspots.label: 确认 v3 并交给 Lead

pages.title: 分派范围与验证责任
pages.focus: Lead 从已确认的 v3 建立上下文包，限定两条可写路径及权限依赖，在活动清单中确认沿用架构、按需插入 ADR 和独立复核责任，然后完成 G1 分派。
pages.method: 内置 ImageGen 研究 Forge 三栏中的结构化上下文与交接会话，引用 Coding Workspace 封面窗体裁切及 Workspace 15.4 秒帧。外部静态画板将上下文和活动清单排在同一个编辑器内，精确设置活动、责任人与 G1 决策文字。
